deadline.value: Fall 2027 application deadline is December 1, 2026 (regular and direct PhD entry).

gre_general.value: GRE is strongly recommended, especially for applicants who studied outside Canada and the US (stated for computer, electrical and software engineering applicants).

also.quote: the Graduate Records Examination (GRE) general test is strongly recommended, especially for applicants who did their studies outside of Canada and the United States

supervisor.value: Supervisor requirement not stated on the pages checked.

funding.value: Lassonde School of Engineering says it provides a guaranteed funding package to all qualified thesis or dissertation graduate students; newly admitted international students averaged CAD 37,000.
funding.quote: The Lassonde School of Engineering provides a competitive, guaranteed funding package to all qualified graduate students pursuing a degree by thesis or dissertation.

entry_route.value: The regular PhD requires a relevant master's degree with a B+ average; a Direct PhD Entry from a bachelor's is also listed (A average).
entry_route.quote: Direct PhD Entry (Electrical Engineering & Computer Science)

also.quote: Applicants must have a Master's degree in Computer Engineering, Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Software Engineering, or a closely related field

toefl_min.value: TOEFL iBT 90-91 (tests before January 2026) or 5 on the new scale (from January 2026), per the program listing.
toefl_min.quote: Minimum TOEFL (Internet-based) 90-91 (for tests taken prior to January 2026) or 5 (January 2026 and after)

ielts_min.value: IELTS Academic 7 overall (program listing; Lassonde page agrees).

also.quote: The following are the minimum English Language test scores (if required): TOEFL: 90(iBT), IELTS 7 or YELT 4.

notes: Single PhD in Electrical Engineering & Computer Science, admitted through Lassonde School of Engineering.
